CheckTitle: MSK (Kafka) clusters with mutual TLS Authentication disabled
Description: Kafka Clusters found with mTLS Authentication disabled. By default, the TLS protocol only requires a server to authenticate itself to the client, and also offers the ability for the server to request that the client send a certificate to prove its identity.
Risk: Not enabling mTLS authentication could expose data streams to unauthorized access and interception.

Recommendation.Text: Ensure mTLS is enabled for your clusters.
